name: 17504-chatdecode-8b-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3 (one GPU of an a3 node, --gres=gpu:1).
architecture: Target: LlamaForCausalLM, 32 layers, 32 query / 8 KV heads, head_dim 128, hidden 4096, bf16, 8.03B params (16.1 GB). Draft: one Llama decoder layer over hidden 4096, fp16, 850 MB, own window 2048.
load_profile: concurrent (CLOSED loop), streams=4, bounded at 320 requests / 900 s safety, warmup the first 25% by completion -- one pass of the 80-row file discarded, three measured.
workload: guidellm `json_file`, single turn, no prefix_buckets: `configs/data/gsm8k-eagle-turn1.jsonl`, 80 grade-school-maths questions, one user turn each, cycled 4 times to make the 320-request bound. The backend renders each prompt as a {"role":"user"} message through the model's chat template. Output is FIXED AT 256 TOKENS per request (max_tokens=256 with ignore_eos=True, so generation continues past the natural stop), greedy at temperature 0.0.
purpose: A grade-school maths tutor with draft-assisted generation, answering single-turn questions in fixed 256-token replies at four concurrent streams on one GPU.
launch:
model: NousResearch/Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct
speculative-config: {"method": "eagle3", "model": "yuhuili/EAGLE3-LLaMA3.1-Instruct-8B", "num_speculative_tokens": 3, "draft_tensor_parallel_size": 1, "max_model_len": 2048}
tensor-parallel-size: 1
max-model-len: 2048
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.8
max-num-seqs: 8
max-num-batched-tokens: 2048
trust-remote-code: true
dtype: bfloat16
enforce-eager: false
enable-prefix-caching: false
